title: Scalar extension homology respects isomorphic K-flat derived models
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings in one universe and f:R→S a ring homomorphism. Suppose P and Q are complexes of R-modules such that tensoring every acyclic complex with either is acyclic [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. If Q_R(P) ≅ Q_R(Q) in the derived category [def-pc-derived-category], then for every integer i the degree-i homology modules of termwise extension of P and Q along f are S-linearly equivalent. No derived category of S-modules, boundedness, termwise flatness, or flatness of f is required.

source.place: Tags 064L and 06Y0; K-flat resolution roof and invariance of tensor under quasi-isomorphisms

proof.text: Convert the acyclic-tensor condition to categorical K-flatness using kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic in the source library. Symmetry supplies the opposite tensor order. Represent the derived isomorphism by DerivedCategory.right_fac; both roof legs are quasi-isomorphisms since their localized maps are invertible.

Use the source library ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution, its reduced resolutionFunctor and resolutionNatTrans to replace the roof source L by a K-flat L′ quasi-isomorphic to L. The two composites to P and Q are quasi-isomorphisms by composition.

Apply mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso to each composite with the complex of the S tensor unit in degree zero. mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso and the left unitor identify this mixed total tensor with termwise extendScalars f. Their naturality gives an arrow isomorphism, so termwise scalar extension of both composites is a quasi-isomorphism.
Degree-i homology of both extended roof legs is invertible. Compose the inverse of the left homology isomorphism with the right homology isomorphism and apply ModuleCat.toLinearEquiv.

theorem nonempty_kFlat_scalarExtension_homology_linearEquiv
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (mapBifunctor L P (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hQ : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (mapBifunctor L Q (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).homology i
      ≃ₗ[S]
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q).homology i)
